soalan: Read the notice: 'The Kindness Club will collect used books this Saturday at the school hall from 9 a.m. to noon.' Where will the books be collected?

soalan: Read the paragraph: 'Small acts of kindness, such as greeting a lonely neighbour or helping a classmate, can brighten someone's whole day.' What is the main idea of this paragraph?
pilihan: Small kind acts can make people happy
Classmates need a lot of help

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word to complete the sentence: 'The volunteers showed great _____ towards the flood victims.'

What a generous act that was.
what a generous act that was!

soalan: In the sentence 'The generous donor gave freely without expecting anything in return', the word 'generous' is closest in meaning to _____.
maklum_balas: The context of giving freely without reward shows 'generous' means 'giving', so option B is correct.

soalan: You are writing a thank-you note to your teacher for her help. Which greeting uses the most appropriate formal register?
pilihan: Dear Madam, I would like to thank you sincerely.
maklum_balas: A note to a teacher requires a polite, formal register; 'Dear Madam, I would like to thank you sincerely' is the appropriate choice.

soalan: Which sentence uses an informal register suitable for a message to a close friend?
pilihan: I am writing to request your kind assistance.
Would you be so kind as to assist me?
Can you give me a hand this weekend?
I should be most grateful for your help.
maklum_balas: 'Can you give me a hand' is casual and friendly, matching the informal register for a close friend.

soalan: Read: 'Aisha spends every Sunday morning reading stories to children at the orphanage. She has done this for two years.' How long has Aisha been volunteering?
maklum_balas: The text states she 'has done this for two years', so option B is the correct detail.

soalan: During a formal school assembly speech about kindness, which opening is most appropriate?
pilihan: Good morning, respected teachers and fellow students.
maklum_balas: A formal assembly speech requires a respectful greeting; option B uses the appropriate formal register.

soalan: A friend tells you she returned a lost wallet to its owner. Which response best expresses appropriate feeling?
pilihan: That was really thoughtful of you; I'm proud of you.
Why did you bother doing that?
That is none of my business.
You should have kept the money.
maklum_balas: The situation calls for expressing warm approval, which option A does appropriately.

soalan: You hear a speaker say: 'Honestly, I feel we simply do not do enough to help the elderly in our community.' What is the speaker's attitude?

maklum_balas: The phrase 'we simply do not do enough' shows the speaker is concerned that more should be done, so option B is correct.

soalan: A writer states: 'While donating money is easy, giving your time and attention is the truest form of kindness.' What can be inferred about the writer's opinion?
pilihan: Donating money should never be done
The writer values personal involvement more than money
Kindness is impossible for busy people
Money is the only way to help
maklum_balas: By contrasting easy donations with giving time and attention as the 'truest' kindness, the writer values personal involvement most, so option B is the correct inference.

soalan: In a short story, a boy quietly pays for a stranger's groceries and leaves before being thanked. What feeling does this scene most likely provoke in the reader, and why?
pilihan: Anger, because the boy wasted money
Admiration, because his kindness was selfless and humble
Confusion, because the act made no sense
maklum_balas: Helping anonymously without seeking thanks is selfless and humble, which most naturally provokes admiration, so option B is correct.

soalan: In a discussion, a student argues that schools should make community service compulsory. Which statement best justifies this point of view?
pilihan: Because everyone else is doing it anyway
Because compulsory service builds empathy and helps students understand real needs
Because students have nothing better to do
Because teachers want it that way
maklum_balas: A strong justification gives a reasoned benefit; option B explains that compulsory service builds empathy and awareness, properly justifying the view.

soalan: Read: 'Nurul Izzah founded a reading centre in her village and now teaches fifty children every weekend.' How many children does she teach?
maklum_balas: The text clearly states she teaches 'fifty children', so option B is the correct detail.

soalan: Read: 'A true role model is not someone who is famous, but someone whose actions inspire others to do good.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Role models inspire others through their actions
Fame is the most important quality

soalan: When explaining why you admire an athlete as a role model, which sentence best states an advantage of following his example?

soalan: Which sentence best states the main point of an argument that parents can be role models?

Parents watch a lot of television.

soalan: You are introducing a guest speaker who is a national athlete at a formal event. Which introduction is most appropriate?

Okay so this person does sports or whatever.

soalan: A writer says: 'We often admire celebrities, yet the real heroes are the quiet teachers and nurses who never make the headlines.' What is the writer's opinion?

soalan: A student claims that fictional superheroes make poor role models. Which statement best justifies this view?

soalan: In a biography, a character rises from poverty to become a doctor who returns to serve her village. Which theme does this development best illustrate?

soalan: You hear a student say: 'For me, no footballer compares to my mother, who works two jobs and still helps me study.' What is the speaker's opinion?

soalan: A student argues that government services should all move online. Which statement best justifies this view?
